summary: Apollomics Inc. furnished a Form 6-K containing a press release of full-year 2025 financial results, clinical updates on vebreltinib, and business progress. No special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC transaction, or forced management change is disclosed.
